---
title: "`r b <- readRDS(params$bundle); b$authors$name[b$authors$author_id == params$author]`"
subtitle: "Bibliometric impact, trajectory and outlook"
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    toc: true
    theme: null
    css: report.css
params:
  bundle: ""
  author: ""
  app_r: ""
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, dev = "ragg_png", dpi = 200,
                      fig.width = 7.5, fig.height = 4.2, fig.align = "left")
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(dplyr); library(ggplot2) })
for (f in sort(list.files(params$app_r, pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE))) source(f)
b <- readRDS(params$bundle)
a <- params$author
x <- b$compare[b$compare$author_id == a, ]
ids <- b$authors$author_id
unit <- .unit_lab(x$unit)
wc <- wrap_caption
```

<p class="asof">Citation counts from `r unit` as of `r format(x$unit_date, "%d %B %Y")`; field normalized impact and five year window from OpenAlex`r if (!is.na(x$openalex_date) && x$openalex_date != x$unit_date) paste0(" as of ", format(x$openalex_date, "%d %B %Y"))`.`r if (nzchar(x$orcid)) paste0(" ORCID ", x$orcid, ".")` Generated `r format(Sys.Date(), "%d %B %Y")` by pubtrack.</p>

## Summary

<div class="stmt">`r impact_statement(b, a)`</div>

**Table 1.** Key indices.

```{r}
knitr::kable(key_indices_table(x), align = "lc")
```

## Trajectory

```{r, fig.cap = "**Figure 1.** Citations received per calendar year."}
wc(plot_hist(b, a))
```

```{r, fig.cap = "**Figure 2.** h index over time in the table's unit: weekly snapshots (solid) and reconstructed year ends (dashed)."}
wc(plot_trajectory(b, a, "h", x$unit, a)) + ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r, fig.cap = "**Figure 3.** Publication portfolio by year and citations; point area shows projected citations in the next 12 months."}
wc(plot_portfolio(b, a))
```

## Outlook

```{r, fig.cap = "**Figure 4.** Projected h index with 80% and 95% prediction intervals."}
wc(plot_fan(b, a, "h"))
```

```{r, fig.cap = "**Figure 5.** Projected total citations with 80% and 95% prediction intervals."}
wc(plot_fan(b, a, "citations_total"))
```

**Table 2.** Papers closest to lifting the h index by one.

```{r}
f <- h_frontier(b$papers[b$papers$author_id == a & !is.na(b$papers$unit_citations), ])
knitr::kable(dplyr::transmute(f, Rank = rank, Title = title, Citations = unit_citations, Needed = needed,
                              `Next 12 months` = fmt_interval(f12_med, f12_lo, f12_hi, isTRUE(x$forecast_ok))), align = "clccc")
```

## Most impactful publications

**Table 3.** Ten most cited publications.

```{r}
knitr::kable(top_papers(b, a, "citations", 10) |>
  dplyr::transmute(Title = title, Year = as.integer(year), Venue = clean_venue(venue), Citations = fmt_n(unit_citations),
                   FWCI = fmt_n(fwci, 2),
                   `Next 12 months` = fmt_interval(f12_med, f12_lo, f12_hi, isTRUE(x$forecast_ok))), align = "lclccc")
```

**Table 4.** Highest field weighted impact (papers with at least ten citations).

```{r}
knitr::kable(top_papers(b, a, "fwci", 5) |>
  dplyr::transmute(Title = title, Year = as.integer(year), FWCI = fmt_n(fwci, 2),
                   Percentile = fmt_pct(pct_value, 1), Citations = fmt_n(unit_citations)), align = "lcccc")
```

```{r, results = "asis"}
if (length(ids) > 1) cat("## Comparison with tracked authors\n")
```

```{r, eval = length(ids) > 1, fig.height = 5.5, fig.cap = "**Figure 6.** Profile across tracked authors (shade ranks each metric within the set)."}
wc(plot_heat(b, ids, a))
```

```{r, eval = length(ids) > 1, fig.cap = "**Figure 7.** Cumulative citations by academic age."}
wc(plot_career(b, ids, "citations", a))
```
